requirements.statement: Under the default lifetime on Linux, setsid and setpgid MUST fail with EPERM in every caged process on tiers T1 and T2, and dropping the handle MUST kill a double-forked descendant.

acceptance.given: the default lifetime on T1 and on T2
acceptance.when: a caged process calls setsid and setpgid

acceptance.given: a double-forked descendant on T1 and on T2
acceptance.then: the descendant is dead within two seconds
